**HOLD** — SHA256 `b154c3a0abde14657e5e3bc6877328dfab5caa6577e5b5ce039a11d114a83d77` Inspected first: desktop grid (candidate-1074.png) and phone full-description dialog (candidate-390-detail.png), then copy.md, source-facts.txt, source-diff.patch. **What the change gets right** - The awkward aside ("—or a Ghostbuster, our spirit-free version—") is gone from both card and full description; the diff touches only this one article's `data-summary` and `

`. - Spirit-free is now stated plainly as a preference, not an apologetic gloss. - Retained and verified in the rendered images: "Romy and Michele asked for the businesswomen's special. We made one." opening, "Business credentials optional." ending, artwork, type, six compact equal-height cards with no overflow or reflow against siblings, and the direct "Visit the Businesswomen's Special" route. **Material finding (why HOLD)** The replacement misstates the game's structure. Source-facts shows two peer lanes chosen by the player before anything is dealt — `Summon Spirits / Cocktails` and `Ghostbusters / Spirit-Free` under "1 · Pick your lane" — with the lede calling it an "equally complete spirit-free lane" and the footer stating "Cocktail and spirit-free have equal representation." The new sentence pair inverts that: "pick a cocktail and a conversation starter" makes cocktail the default outcome, and "Ghostbuster (spirit-free) options are available if you prefer" demotes an equal lane to an accommodation available on request. It also drops the fact that the player chooses the lane; the fortune teller deals only after that choice. The card's own tag ("Happy hour · cocktails & Ghostbusters") is even-handed, so the body now reads against its tag as well as against the game. This is a support/accuracy mismatch in the exact sentence under review, so it belongs in this one correction rather than a follow-up. Both surfaces (card and full description) carry the identical wording and would need the same fix.
